**3B.3 Note**
Xi Jinping’s 2024 record does **not** show clear, direct personal incitement to hate or violence against minorities, journalists, or civil society. The strongest evidence is **indirect**: nationalist, anti-separatist, and “threat inflation” framing around Taiwan and external interference. There is also a narrower counter-signal in repeated diplomatic/de-escalatory rhetoric.

| Assessment | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| Partial positive | [Xi told Blinken that China and the U.S. should be partners and maintain peaceful coexistence](https://www.mfa.gov.cn/mfa_eng/xw/zyxw/202405/t20240530_11332906.html) | PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs | 2024-04-26 | https://www.mfa.gov.cn/mfa_eng/xw/zyxw/202405/t20240530_11332906.html | This is a de-escalatory signal, not an incitement signal. It weighs against a reading that Xi was personally mobilizing hatred against foreign opponents in this bilateral context. | `3B.3`, `2B.6`, `2B.7` |
| Partial positive | [Wang Yi said China has no intention to displace or lord over anyone, warned against “threat inflation”](https://www.mfa.gov.cn/mfa_eng/xw/zyxw/202405/t20240530_11332615.html) | PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs | 2024-05-30 | https://www.mfa.gov.cn/mfa_eng/xw/zyxw/202405/t20240530_11332615.html | Official messaging attributed to Xi’s diplomatic line explicitly rejects threat inflation. That is the clearest counterweight to a claim of personal hate-mongering, though it remains rhetorical. | `3B.3`, `2B.6` |
| Partial positive | [China said it would promote peace talks on Ukraine, stop “fueling the fire,” and oppose bloc confrontation](https://www.mfa.gov.cn/eng/wjb/wjbz/jh/202405/t20240527_11312271.html) | PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs | 2024-05-27 | https://www.mfa.gov.cn/eng/wjb/wjbz/jh/202405/t20240527_11312271.html | This is anti-escalatory language that cuts against incitement-to-violence readings, at least in the Ukraine context. It does not prove restraint elsewhere, but it is relevant negative evidence. | `3B.3`, `2B.7` |
| Negative, indirect | [Xi framed Taiwan as historically inseparable and reunification as part of national identity and historical destiny](https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202404/11/content_WS6617c935c6d0868f4e8e5f4f.html) | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-04-11 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202404/11/content_WS6617c935c6d0868f4e8e5f4f.html | This is nationalist grievance framing. It is not explicit hate speech, but it uses historical destiny rhetoric that can mobilize hostility toward Taiwanese opponents and “separatists.” | `3B.3`, `2B.6` |
| Negative, indirect | [Xi paired opposition to Taiwan independence and external interference with a national-rejuvenation narrative](https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202402/09/content_WS65c5f9c7c6d0868f4e8e3e98.html) | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-02-09 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202402/09/content_WS65c5f9c7c6d0868f4e8e3e98.html | This is not a direct call for violence, but it is classic scapegoating language that defines opponents as existential threats to the nation. | `3B.3`, `2B.6` |
| Negative, indirect | [China publicly claimed it wanted peaceful cross-Strait development while opposing Taiwan independence and external interference](https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202403/05/content_WS65e67b83c6d0868f4e8e4a62.html) | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-03-05 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202403/05/content_WS65e67b83c6d0868f4e8e4a62.html | The “peaceful development” language is a restraint claim, but the paired anti-separatist framing keeps the rhetoric adversarial and grievance-driven. | `3B.3`, `2B.6`, `2B.7` |
| Negative, indirect | [The PLA announced combat-readiness patrols, precision strikes, and a “stern warning” to Taiwan independence forces](https://eng.mod.gov.cn/xb/News_213114/TopStories/16310652.html) | PRC Ministry of National Defense / Xinhua | 2024-05-23 | https://eng.mod.gov.cn/xb/News_213114/TopStories/16310652.html | This is coercive signaling rather than personal hate speech, but it normalizes punitive language against a labeled enemy category. It supports a broader hostile-mobilization reading. | `3B.3`, `2B.2`, `2B.6` |
| Negative, indirect | [China launched “punishment” drills around Taiwan days after Lai Ching-te’s inauguration](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/china-launches-war-games-around-taiwan-3453328) | Reuters | 2024-05-22 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/china-launches-war-games-around-taiwan-3453328 | Reuters’ framing captures the punitive tone of the campaign: not merely defense, but punishment of a political opponent. That is not proof of ethnic hatred, but it is relevant to incitement through revenge framing. | `3B.3`, `2B.2`, `2B.6` |

**Synthesis**
- **Best read:** **No clear direct incitement**, but **yes to indirect scapegoating / hostile framing**.
- I found no reliable 2024 evidence of Xi personally calling for violence against Uyghurs, Tibetans, migrants, journalists, or civil society as a category.
- The strongest negative evidence is **Taiwan-focused**: historical destiny, national rejuvenation, anti-separatist, and “punishment” language.
- The strongest positive evidence is the opposite style: “peaceful coexistence,” “no intention to displace,” and “stop fueling the fire.”

**Search gap**
- I did not find a credible 2024 source showing Xi personally used explicit dehumanizing or revenge language against journalists, minorities, migrants, or religious groups.
- The record supports **hostile nationalist framing**, not a documented campaign of explicit hate incitement by Xi himself.
